content: Sank Wulapm Weinkel Ka Sankork Sank Yapmunemp Moule Kitapmelel
Ekilelel i, nti Farisi mpurel antempel nti moule wupm raiel yek Jerusalem la i amiser Jisas. I nti amiyimpil na,
“Apulntaku nti moule ka sop yiknel, nti karokn apul sop sank antuel mesepmelel ka ampueik mporantunel, ka apulpi? Nti moule aiyipmel karokn kaikul nta niorkn nako nti yel niepmel.”

I Jisas ampu nakimp nti na, “Eti apm'a niyim yipm, apulntaku yipm ampu ka walimp sank Wulapm Weinkel mper sank yapmunemp mesepmel irpm aiyipmelel miniorkn? Pe sank niawurpmel Wulapm Weinkel ampueik ka mporantunel ka yipm ampu wamiker, ka apulpi?

Wulapm Weink nak na, Yikn ko niremp waiek mantiek aiyipmel, eipm sank antuel yupul nti sepm. Pe kil ampu nak na, Kona mewel aiyipmel niekilai waiek mantiek ankilelel, arai yipm yer kil wuntu. (Kisim Bek 20:12 yintempel 21:17)

Ampueikel Wulapm Weink ka nakimp yipm sank niawurpmel epie, aser yipm ka apul sop yapmunemp milman mipmakn aiyipmelel suwaink. Yipm ka nakimp waiek mantiek aiyipmel na wuntokn yipm mper apulp na wakerp ntiel ka miniat. Ka apulpaser wuntokn epe karep yikn amuk Wulapm Weink. Nti mesepmel aiyipmel ka nakimp yipm na yipm ka apul akosepm. Nti nak nana yipm korokn numpul yupulp sank niawurpmel Wulapm Weinkel ka nak na yipm kapuko niremp waiek mantiek aiyipmel yupul nti sepmel. Ka mekitik. Apulntaku! Ka kuret! Yipm ka wamiker sank niawurpmel Wulapm Weinkel kana yer nuarep mpuampua kuserel. Wuntokn aiyipmel yipm karokn akei wakerp nti waiek mantiek aiyipmel apulp nti sepm.
Ka yipm akei wule kurieknel nak sank ninkaielel! Ampueikel Aisaia, moule ka nakaworp yapmunemp Wulapm Weinkelel, ka nak amorp sankwunamp aiyipmel ntape na,
Wulapm Weink ka nak na, Nti mentitmaken epe ka akei niepm kurieknel aiki nia apmilel, pe yapmunemp pmiempniumpuaipm antuel ka apei yempel.
Nti ka nkamp sank yapmunemp antuel manmaknel nak na, Epie ka sank Wulapm Weinkel. Aser ka nti nak yapmunemp moule kitapmelel, naremp apm kuserel.” (Aisaia 29:13)
Jisas Yuwap Nti Apulp Simi Ka Kuret Sankorkel
Kapepe Jisas aiyimp nti mentitmaken la aser kil i, kil nakimp nti na, “Yipm eipm sank epie, wunempwaiyimp aipopel.

Niepm ka yipm alel, kapukorokn yupul yikn i yikn kuret sankorkel yer niampepm Wulapm Weinkel. Karokn. Aser sank yapmunemp ka yek yekipmin naikul niepmel, ekilelel ka apul moule kuret sankorkel apmuei niampepm Wulapm Weinkelel.”
Niatel i, nti moule ka sop Jisasel la i nakimp Jisas na, “Nti Farisi ka wunemp'uret apulp sank pe yikn nak i nti eipmel.”

I Jisas ampu nak sanklomp nak na, “Waiek apmilel po ar na yemp keipmelel ka are niokn, pe kil akeimp niepm ar. Pe nimum ninkakn irpm ka kil karokn akeimpel, arai kil nuromp yintempel niamp sukur muat.

Eti ka yipm korokn yapmunemp wankepm yupulp nti Farisi. Nti ka nuarep moule ka akei tukulpmel at, i na ntremp kuap mewel niampepm tukulpmel yayapelel. Kona ntiwuye yet yintempel, arai ntiwuye yintempel nkiyi yo lie.”
I Pita ampu nakimp Jisas na, “Eti yikn ampu niek yuworp niupukn sanklompel pe yikn nakimp nti ntitmakenelel, ant ampu eipm.”
I Jisas nak na, “Ka apulntaku? Yipm'arokn eipm kankre mi?
Eti yipm nimpil eipm. Niepm ka yipm alel ka yek kuriekn war yekipminel, ka a ar lunko eti ka aiye muat. Eti mpuampua epe karokn apul moule kuret sankorkel ar niampepm Wulapm Weinkel.
Aser ka sankwunamp aiyipmel pe ka yek yekipmin naikul niepm kurieknel ka nkarp ar yapmunemp. I ka mpuampua pepe ka apul yipm kuret sankorkel ar niampepm Wulapm Weinkelel.

Ka apm nak apulp sankwunamp irpm ka nkarp ar yapmunemp mouleelel, ka ntalekil. Kona yipm aim yapmunemp'uretel miel, pe ka yipm aimpar moule wuntuelel, pe ka yikn apul wurkite, pe ka sank ninkaielel ka yikn nak ar niampepm antuel moule lowulaelel mi sank kuretel ka yipm nkamp mperp mewelel, pe yapmunemp aiyiknel nkarp na yupul tniompreimp irpmel.

Wunamp irpm ntakilelel ka apul moule na yer kuret sankorkel yer niampepm Wulapm Weinkel. Pe moule karokn kaikul nta sop sank antuel manmaknelel, epie karokn apul moule na yer kuret sankorkel yer niampepm Wulapm Weinkelel.”
Makenel Kenanel Ka Yapmunemp Mintenk Apulp Jisas
Kapepe Jisas awomp yemp epe apmuei i kil mpim yempel ka ar nantip yemp suknel Tair irpm Saidonel.

Pe makenel Kenanel karokn ntieyarkup antuel Judaelel, ka ar pepe. Kil la akei mpeiknel aiyimp Jisas i nak na, “Sepmel, Knamniumpuai Devitel, yikn wunempyupulp apm! Ninkilapm maken apmilel ka muanumpor yanker aimpil kuret ankil.”
Aser Jisas karokn ampu nakimpil sank wainkiwainkiel. Kapepe, nti moule ka sop Jisasel mpi i namikimp Jisas na, “Maken epe ka ma aworawor nkirnker yatip. Yikn ampu wankesil mpim.”
I Jisas ampu nakimp nti na, “Wulapm Weink ka wankes apm na simpop nti ntitmaken Israelel likekn. Nti ka nuarep wus sipsip ka yawopmel ar yempelel.”
Aser maken epe la kitnan i kil waker nkaikyumpo eip kitapm apulp na yiki nia Jisaselel i kil nak na, “Sepmel, ko yikn yupulp apm!”
I Jisas ampu nakimp maken epe sanklomp na, “Ant korokn simpop nti ninkilapm niepm na mperp niumpua.”
Aser maken epe ampu nak na, “Sepmel, ka yikn nak wat amu ntunk. Aser nti niumpua, nti ka nuanti niepm nirepm ka naikul a kitapmel pe.”

Jisas eipm sank ekilelel i kil ampu nankimpil na, “Mantiek, yapmunemp aiyiknel ka mintenk yatip ar apmel! Eti puikn aiyiknel yikn apulp na nininkel, kako ninink.” Ankrik ka Jisas nak sank ntakilelel i, ninkilapm maken ankilel epe ampu ka akosepmim.
Jisas Apul Nti Moule Mitinkel Ampu Sepmim
Jisas awomp yemp epe apmuei i, kil at sop mpepwarmp Galili mita mpim. Kil mpi namp malenk i kil nkupmus.

Kapepe nti moule ntitmaken mitinkel arko la amiser kil. Nti mpurel ka nkaik kuretelel, antempel nti moule ka ntankaik awur mpilmpilelel, antempel nti ka niampepm liknelel, antempel nti ka niepm nanintipelel sank karokn nakel, antempel nti minimini ka wulenip apulel, nti apul ntiarko la i mper nti ar kitnan namintip Jisas, i kil ampu apul nti akosepmim.

Kapepe nti moule ntitmaken amiser nti ka niepm nanintipel ampu napmok sank, pe nti ka ntankaik awur mpilmpilelel ampu ka akosepmim, pe nti ka ntankaik kuretelel nti ampu ka apmot wunamp. Antempel nti ka niampepm liknelel, niampepm nti ampu ka nimin. Eti nti ka yapmunemp pupurur ampulp Jisas, i nti aimiki nia Wulapm Weink Israelel namp keipm.
Jisas Ak Nti 4,000 Moule Niepm Al

Jisas aiyimp nti moule ka sopilel la i kil nakimp nti na, “Apm wunempampulp nti moule ntitmaken epe. Nti antemp apm ar awun wuyelikeknelim, eti nti ka niepm karoknim. Apm'arokn apulp na apm'a wankes nti yikei nilmpel mpi. Nilmp'o yer ntiel, niampepm ko nu nti, i nti ko nkiyi yer yayapel tikikn.”
I nti moule ka sop Jisasel nakimpil na, “Nti ka mitink yatip, ko ant somp niepm mitinkel yer oku nako ant yek nti yelel? Yemp epie ka moule karokn ar.”
I Jisas namiyim nti na, “Eti niepm atipm pe yipm apulel?” I nti nak na, “Ant apul 7-pla luwu ntintir antempel yokn akopiteknel mpurel, karokn mitink.”
Kapepe Jisas nakimp nti ntitmaken na nkupmus kitapm.
Kil nkamp 7-pla luwu ntintir antempel yokn, i kil nak namiremp Wulapm Weink i kil waker awor amuk nti moule ka sopilel. Kapepe nti moule ka sop Jisasel nkamp i amuk nti ntitmaken.
I nti al mpimpi aser lunkoim, i nti moule ka sop Jisasel nkamp niepm wainki wainki ka nti al nkisel aim amu 7-pla rumpunkel.
Nti mentit ka al niepm ekilelel ka 4,000 pe nti maken ninkilapm ka nti karokn waperp nti.
Kapepe i, Jisas wankes nti ntitmaken ampul likekn wuye, pe kil ka yukur na sil wutumpepel i kil po mpim kitapm antuel Magadenel.

footnotes.text: 15.2 15:2 - Sank epie apulp kaikul ntael karokn nak apulp nta antuel ka sikep apulel. Karokn. Ka nak apulp niokn likekn nti ka apulel. Nti ka kaikul nta kuserel apulpaser nti ka wunempwaiyimp na ka yayapel ko yupul nti na yer sepm ntinkiraiel yer niampepm Wulapm Weinkel.

15.26 Sanklomp apulp ninkilapmel ka muati apulp nti Israel, pe sanklomp apulp niumpuael ka muati apulp nti moule karokn ntieyarkup Judaelel. Jisas nak na sank Wulapm Weinkel kana yek nti Israel niorkn, kona niatel i ko yumuk nti moule kurieknel, nti karokn ntieyarkup Judaelel.
